text:
Priya Rao: Hey team — heads up: I'm planning parental leave starting Oct 10 for ~12 weeks. Quick Qs: is there a backup childcare / nanny subsidy we can tap for the first 6 weeks? Also need a tidy handoff checklist for on-call and the weekly product sync. Partner's working hybrid (WFH Tue/Thu) so gaps are afternoons.

people-ops-bot: Hi Priya! Please see the parental benefits guide: https://intranet.redwood/people/parental-benefits. There is a short intake form you can fill to start subsidy approval.

Jae Park: @Priya Rao — yes, we have a temporary childcare subsidy for qualifying full-time employees. Base policy: up to $1,200/month for up to 6 months for licensed childcare or vetted backup caregivers. Subsidy requires completed intake + receipts. I'll DM the form.

Todd Lin: Quick payroll note: subsidy is processed as a non-taxable reimbursement if receipts show qualified care. Submit via HR portal under Reimbursements > Parental > "Backup Childcare". Deadlines: submit invoices within 60 days of service.

Michelle Torres: @Priya I can cover your weekly product sync the first 4 weeks and coordinate async notes. Sam, can you pick up on-call rotation weeks 1 and 3?

Sam Kim: I can take weeks 1 and 3 on-call. Add me to the rotation and i'll shadow you the week before. Also can triage urgent bugs during afternoons. :thumbsup:

Priya Rao: Thanks — appreciate it. For the handoff, here's a tiny draft checklist, feel free to edit:
```
- export pager runbook + escalation contacts
- mark critical PRs and owners
- assign doc owner for weekly sync notes
- share access to metrics dashboard + alerts
- list recurring stakeholder touchpoints
- set up calendar holds for handover week
```

Nina Alvarez: On legal: if any third-party contracts require active approver signatures while you're out, list them now. We can add an alternate signer for approvals < $10k via doc signature policy.

Jae Park: Also FYI — equipment: if you want to keep your company laptop, you can. If you're flying internationally during leave, check with IT about VPN and security. If you prefer a temporary device for a backup caregiver use, we can arrange that (rare).

Priya Rao: Good to know. I will fill the intake form today and attach sample invoices. Can someone confirm the expected turnaround for subsidy approval?

Todd Lin: Typical processing time is 7-10 business days after intake + receipt upload. If it's urgent we can expedite to 3-5 days with a note.

Michelle Torres: I'll block the handover week on the calendar and create a short doc in the team drive. @Priya send me any prioritized PRs and I'll list owners.

Sam Kim: I'll set up a 30m shadow session next Tue to go over the runbook.

Priya Rao: Amazing, thank you all. Will post the intake form confirmation here once submitted. :raised_hands:
